name: task-completion-guard
description: Keep execution tasks running until Codex submits a structured, evidence-backed completion audit.

interface.shortDescription: Prevent implementation tasks from ending after a partial step.
interface.longDescription: Automatically enrolls implementation tasks in a bounded completion audit, records observable change and verification evidence, and continues Codex when its final completion declaration is incomplete or inconsistent with that evidence.
defaultPrompt: Implement this feature completely and verify the result.
Fix this bug without stopping at an intermediate step.
